{"designSystems":[{"name":"assets/570ff0bbe6684091893f4dd4d18482cd","designSystem":{"displayName":"Executive Planning Workspace","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system delivers a calm, authoritative, high-trust analytical environment tailored for executive advisors and corporate decision-makers. The aesthetic blends institutional investment advisory rigor with the clarity of modern enterprise software.

### Aesthetic Foundation
- **Discipline & Clarity**: Every element serves an analytical purpose. Decorative gradients, heavy blur effects, and generic "AI glow" motifs are strictly prohibited.
- **Understated Confidence**: The visual tone relies on deep maritime navies, structural hairline rules, and generous micro-spacing. It communicates institutional stability and precise forecasting.
- **Dual Provenance**: Visual hierarchy clearly prioritizes the advisory partner's front-line relationship, supported underneath by unobtrusive technical intelligence attribution.

## Layout & Spacing

The interface uses a desktop-first architecture targeted at 1440x900 viewports with support for broader displays.

### Global Framework Architecture
- **Fixed Sidebar (240px)**: Left-aligned structural shell containing tenant identity, primary navigational taxonomy, and partner intelligence attribution.
- **Fixed Top Utility Bar (68px)**: Anchored directly beside the sidebar, housing client context (`Harbor Coast Beverages`), portfolio category indicators, cycle dates, and intelligence timestamp pills.
- **Main Content Shell**: Stretches across the viewport with a maximum constrained content boundary of `1280px` to maintain optimal data scanning length.

### Grid & Density
- **Main Canvas Grid**: 12-column responsive layout utilizing `1.25rem` (20px) gutters and `1.5rem` (24px) exterior padding.
- **Analytical Cards**: Internal layout operates on standard multiples: `space-xs` (4px) for metric tags, `space-sm` (8px) for title-to-subtitle relationships, `space-md` (16px) for module padding, and `space-lg` (24px) for major card divisions.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp boundary containment over pronounced drop shadows to preserve data density and reduce eye fatigue.

### Elevation Architecture
- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#F6F8FB` flat surface. All analytical modules and sidebars anchor directly to this foundation.
- **Level 1 (Card & Module Shells)**: `#FFFFFF` fill bounded by a crisp 1px solid `#E4E9F0` perimeter border. A single ultra-soft ambient shadow (`0 1px 3px rgba(16, 35, 63, 0.04)`) separates foreground analysis blocks from the canvas base.
- **Level 2 (Dropdowns, Flyouts & Filter Menus)**: `#FFFFFF` fill, 1px `#E4E9F0` perimeter, and directional drop shadow (`0 4px 12px rgba(16, 35, 63, 0.08)`).
- **Level 3 (Scenario Overlays & Model Drawers)**: `#FFFFFF` surface elevated over an analytical scrim (`#10233F` at 24% opacity) with a defined lateral shadow (`-4px 0 24px rgba(16, 35, 63, 0.12)`).

### Hairline Rules
- Never use full-width heavy shadows to segment internal card sections. Use 1px `#E4E9F0` horizontal and vertical dividing rules.

## Components

### Buttons & Interactive Controls
- **Primary Button**: Solid `#2563EB` fill, `#FFFFFF` text, `font-weight: 500`, 8px radius, height: 36px. Hover state: `#1D4ED8`. Active state: `#1E40AF`. Focus-visible ring: 2px `#2563EB` offset by 2px white.
- **Secondary Button**: `#FFFFFF` background, 1px `#E4E9F0` border, `#162033` text. Hover: `#F6F8FB` fill with `#CBD5E1` border stroke.
- **Tertiary / Utility Action**: Transparent background, `#667085` text, transitions to `#10233F` on hover.

### Status Pills & Context Badges
- Status pills must pair an explicit status color indicator (dot or icon) with uppercase or medium-weight label copy.
- **High Risk**: `#DC3545` dot or tint border, `#DC3545` text, background: 8% tint of `#DC3545`.
- **Caution**: `#E5A000` dot, `#A16207` text, background: 10% tint of `#E5A000`.
- **Healthy**: `#2E9B62` dot, `#166534` text, background: 8% tint of `#2E9B62`.
- **Overstock / Stagnant**: `#475569` dot, `#334155` text, background: 8% tint of `#475569`.

### Data Cards & KPI Displays
- Container: Surface `#FFFFFF`, 1px solid `#E4E9F0`, 14px radius, `space-md` interior padding.
- Metric Layout: Metric label (`metadata-sm` in `#667085`) positioned above the tabular KPI value (`display-metric` in `#162033`).
- Sub-text / Trend Delta: Appended directly beneath the metric using paired icons and semantic colors.

### Form Inputs & Search Fields
- Default state: Height 36px, background `#FFFFFF`, 1px solid `#E4E9F0`, 8px radius, internal padding `0 12px`, text size 14px.
- Focus state: Border color shifted to `#2563EB` with an external 3px box shadow of `rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12)`.

### Charting & Analytical Visualization
- **Historical Actual Series**: Solid curve or solid bars styled in primary navy (`#10233F`), stroke width 2.5px.
- **Baseline Forecast Series**: Solid curve styled in vibrant blue (`#2563EB`), stroke width 2px.
- **Upside Scenario Series**: Fine stroke or filled area styled in teal (`#0F9D8A`), stroke width 1.5px.
- **Conservative Scenario Series**: Dashed line styled in muted slate (`#667085`), stroke-dasharray `4 4`.

## Brand & Style

This design system delivers a calm, authoritative, high-trust analytical environment tailored for executive advisors and corporate decision-makers. The aesthetic blends institutional investment advisory rigor with the clarity of modern enterprise software.

### Aesthetic Foundation
- **Discipline & Clarity**: Every element serves an analytical purpose. Decorative gradients, heavy blur effects, and generic "AI glow" motifs are strictly prohibited.
- **Understated Confidence**: The visual tone relies on deep maritime navies, structural hairline rules, and generous micro-spacing. It communicates institutional stability and precise forecasting.
- **Dual Provenance**: Visual hierarchy clearly prioritizes the advisory partner's front-line relationship, supported underneath by unobtrusive technical intelligence attribution.

## Colors

The color palette establishes an analytical hierarchy through high-contrast structural values and functional data accents.

### Core Canvas & Structure
- **Primary Navy (`#10233F`)**: Used for page titles, critical navigational headers, high-emphasis icons, and historical actual data series.
- **Interactive Blue (`#2563EB`)**: Directs user attention to primary triggers, baseline projection curves, keyboard focus rings, and active selection states.
- **Intelligence Teal (`#0F9D8A`)**: Reserved for positive analytical insights, upside scenario modeling, and growth projections.
- **Canvas Base (`#F6F8FB`)**: The foundational off-white tint that minimizes display fatigue across 1440x900 desktop displays.
- **Surface Elevation (`#FFFFFF`)**: Pure white card, drawer, and table container surfaces.
- **Structural Stroke (`#E4E9F0`)**: 1px perimeter definition for all cards, table cells, split panes, and header separators.

### Typography Scales
- **Text Primary (`#162033`)**: High-legibility charcoal for metrics, table rows, and body copy.
- **Text Secondary (`#667085`)**: Neutral grey for metadata, column headers, axis labels, and helper descriptions.

### Domain Status Tokens
Status indicators must pair color with explicit text labels:
- **High Risk / Danger (`#DC3545`)**: Stockout projections, unmitigated supply delays, and negative scenario thresholds.
- **Caution / Watch (`#E5A000`)**: Near-threshold lead times and unconfirmed demand swings.
- **Healthy / Steady (`#2E9B62`)**: Target inventory equilibrium and verified supply fulfillment.
- **Overstock / Neutral (`#475569`)**: Capacity surplus and capital allocation warnings.

## Typography

The type system relies on `Inter`, prioritized for structural legibility in numerical density.

### Numerical Integrity
- Apply CSS `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` to all data tables, metric tiles, KPI rollups, and chart tooltips to prevent visual jitter across dynamic updates.
- When pairing numerical values with directional delta indicators (e.g., `+12.4%`), the delta must match the weight of the parent value.

### Type Hierarchy Rules
- Use `headline-h1` strictly for top-level workspace views (Demand Forecast, Scenario Modeling).
- Section grouping inside cards must default to `headline-h3` paired with `metadata-sm` descriptions.
- Use `label-caps` in uppercase format with `letter-spacing: 0.04em` exclusively for navigation group headers, table sort headers, and secondary badge titles.

## Layout & Spacing

## Shapes

The interface balances modern software conventions with advisory restraint using systematic boundary radiuses.

### Geometry Specifications
- **Cards & Data Modules**: Defined at `14px` border radius (`rounded-lg`) to soften structured data blocks without wasting corner area.
- **Interactive Triggers (Buttons, Form Inputs)**: Configured at `8px` radius (`rounded-md`) to ensure clear clickable affordance.

## Brand & Style

This design system delivers a calm, authoritative, high-trust analytical environment tailored for executive advisors and corporate decision-makers. The aesthetic blends institutional investment advisory rigor with the clarity of modern enterprise software.

### Aesthetic Foundation
- **Discipline & Clarity**: Every element serves an analytical purpose. Decorative gradients, heavy blur effects, and generic "AI glow" motifs are strictly prohibited.
- **Understated Confidence**: The visual tone relies on deep maritime navies, structural hairline rules, and generous micro-spacing. It communicates institutional stability and precise forecasting.
- **Dual Provenance**: Visual hierarchy clearly prioritizes the advisory partner's front-line relationship, supported underneath by unobtrusive technical intelligence attribution.

## Colors

The color palette establishes an analytical hierarchy through high-contrast structural values and functional data accents.

### Core Canvas & Structure
- **Primary Navy (`#10233F`)**: Used for page titles, critical navigational headers, high-emphasis icons, and historical actual data series.
- **Interactive Blue (`#2563EB`)**: Directs user attention to primary triggers, baseline projection curves, keyboard focus rings, and active selection states.
- **Intelligence Teal (`#0F9D8A`)**: Reserved for positive analytical insights, upside scenario modeling, and growth projections.
- **Canvas Base (`#F6F8FB`)**: The foundational off-white tint that minimizes display fatigue across 1440x900 desktop displays.
- **Surface Elevation (`#FFFFFF`)**: Pure white card, drawer, and table container surfaces.
- **Structural Stroke (`#E4E9F0`)**: 1px perimeter definition for all cards, table cells, split panes, and header separators.

### Typography Scales
- **Text Primary (`#162033`)**: High-legibility charcoal for metrics, table rows, and body copy.
- **Text Secondary (`#667085`)**: Neutral grey for metadata, column headers, axis labels, and helper descriptions.

### Domain Status Tokens
Status indicators must pair color with explicit text labels:
- **High Risk / Danger (`#DC3545`)**: Stockout projections, unmitigated supply delays, and negative scenario thresholds.
- **Caution / Watch (`#E5A000`)**: Near-threshold lead times and unconfirmed demand swings.
- **Healthy / Steady (`#2E9B62`)**: Target inventory equilibrium and verified supply fulfillment.
- **Overstock / Neutral (`#475569`)**: Capacity surplus and capital allocation warnings.

## Typography

The type system relies on `Inter`, prioritized for structural legibility in numerical density.

### Numerical Integrity
- Apply CSS `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` to all data tables, metric tiles, KPI rollups, and chart tooltips to prevent visual jitter across dynamic updates.
- When pairing numerical values with directional delta indicators (e.g., `+12.4%`), the delta must match the weight of the parent value.

### Type Hierarchy Rules
- Use `headline-h1` strictly for top-level workspace views (Demand Forecast, Scenario Modeling).
- Section grouping inside cards must default to `headline-h3` paired with `metadata-sm` descriptions.
- Use `label-caps` in uppercase format with `letter-spacing: 0.04em` exclusively for navigation group headers, table sort headers, and secondary badge titles.

## Layout & Spacing

The interface uses a desktop-first architecture targeted at 1440x900 viewports with support for broader displays.

### Global Framework Architecture
- **Fixed Sidebar (240px)**: Left-aligned structural shell containing tenant identity, primary navigational taxonomy, and partner intelligence attribution.
- **Fixed Top Utility Bar (68px)**: Anchored directly beside the sidebar, housing client context (`Harbor Coast Beverages`), portfolio category indicators, cycle dates, and intelligence timestamp pills.
- **Main Content Shell**: Stretches across the viewport with a maximum constrained content boundary of `1280px` to maintain optimal data scanning length.

### Grid & Density
- **Main Canvas Grid**: 12-column responsive layout utilizing `1.25rem` (20px) gutters and `1.5rem` (24px) exterior padding.
- **Analytical Cards**: Internal layout operates on standard multiples: `space-xs` (4px) for metric tags, `space-sm` (8px) for title-to-subtitle relationships, `space-md` (16px) for module padding, and `space-lg` (24px) for major card divisions.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp boundary containment over pronounced drop shadows to preserve data density and reduce eye fatigue.

### Elevation Architecture
- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#F6F8FB` flat surface. All analytical modules and sidebars anchor directly to this foundation.
- **Level 1 (Card & Module Shells)**: `#FFFFFF` fill bounded by a crisp 1px solid `#E4E9F0` perimeter border. A single ultra-soft ambient shadow (`0 1px 3px rgba(16, 35, 63, 0.04)`) separates foreground analysis blocks from the canvas base.
- **Level 2 (Dropdowns, Flyouts & Filter Menus)**: `#FFFFFF` fill, 1px `#E4E9F0` perimeter, and directional drop shadow (`0 4px 12px rgba(16, 35, 63, 0.08)`).
- **Level 3 (Scenario Overlays & Model Drawers)**: `#FFFFFF` surface elevated over an analytical scrim (`#10233F` at 24% opacity) with a defined lateral shadow (`-4px 0 24px rgba(16, 35, 63, 0.12)`).

### Hairline Rules
- Never use full-width heavy shadows to segment internal card sections. Use 1px `#E4E9F0` horizontal and vertical dividing rules.

## Shapes

The interface balances modern software conventions with advisory restraint using systematic boundary radiuses.

### Geometry Specifications
- **Cards & Data Modules**: Defined at `14px` border radius (`rounded-lg`) to soften structured data blocks without wasting corner area.
- **Interactive Triggers (Buttons, Form Inputs)**: Configured at `8px` radius (`rounded-md`) to ensure clear clickable affordance.
- **Status Badges & Insight Chips**: Full capsule pill radius (`rounded-full`) to immediately distinguish contextual status indicators from rectangular data containers.
- **Checkboxes & Visual Toggles**: `4px` corner radius (`rounded-sm`).

## Components

### Buttons & Interactive Controls
- **Primary Button**: Solid `#2563EB` fill, `#FFFFFF` text, `font-weight: 500`, 8px radius, height: 36px. Hover state: `#1D4ED8`. Active state: `#1E40AF`. Focus-visible ring: 2px `#2563EB` offset by 2px white.
- **Secondary Button**: `#FFFFFF` background, 1px `#E4E9F0` border, `#162033` text. Hover: `#F6F8FB` fill with `#CBD5E1` border stroke.
- **Tertiary / Utility Action**: Transparent background, `#667085` text, transitions to `#10233F` on hover.

### Status Pills & Context Badges
- Status pills must pair an explicit status color indicator (dot or icon) with uppercase or medium-weight label copy.
- **High Risk**: `#DC3545` dot or tint border, `#DC3545` text, background: 8% tint of `#DC3545`.
- **Caution**: `#E5A000` dot, `#A16207` text, background: 10% tint of `#E5A000`.
- **Healthy**: `#2E9B62` dot, `#166534` text, background: 8% tint of `#2E9B62`.
- **Overstock / Stagnant**: `#475569` dot, `#334155` text, background: 8% tint of `#475569`.

### Data Cards & KPI Displays
- Container: Surface `#FFFFFF`, 1px solid `#E4E9F0`, 14px radius, `space-md` interior padding.
- Metric Layout: Metric label (`metadata-sm` in `#667085`) positioned above the tabular KPI value (`display-metric` in `#162033`).
- Sub-text / Trend Delta: Appended directly beneath the metric using paired icons and semantic colors.

### Form Inputs & Search Fields
- Default state: Height 36px, background `#FFFFFF`, 1px solid `#E4E9F0`, 8px radius, internal padding `0 12px`, text size 14px.
- Focus state: Border color shifted to `#2563EB` with an external 3px box shadow of `rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12)`.

### Charting & Analytical Visualization
- **Historical Actual Series**: Solid curve or solid bars styled in primary navy (`#10233F`), stroke width 2.5px.
- **Baseline Forecast Series**: Solid curve styled in vibrant blue (`#2563EB`), stroke width 2px.
- **Upside Scenario Series**: Fine stroke or filled area styled in teal (`#0F9D8A`), stroke width 1.5px.
- **Conservative Scenario Series**: Dashed line styled in muted slate (`#667085`), stroke-dasharray `4 4`.
- **Chart Grid Lines**: Hairline horizontal axis rules in `#E4E9F0`, 1px stroke, zero vertical grid noise.
